title: Keep the Clarity privacy line next to the analytics in the landing (HomeDocument.astro), never in Base.astro
body: Clarity uses cookies and records sessions (it masks inputs; the site has no forms), CWA uses none. If EU traffic arrives, consent is technically required; the minimum adopted is a footer line saying usage is measured with Clarity, linking Microsoft's privacy statement (`footerPrivacy*` keys in content/schema/messages.ts, rendered in src/components/HomeDocument.astro). It sits with the analytics, not in src/layouts/Base.astro: if analytics are removed the line goes with them instead of being orphaned on /cv. Starting Clarity on first interaction (src/scripts/analytics.ts) is NOT a consent banner and must not be described as one — it changes when measurement starts, not what is collected. A real consent mechanism is still open if EU traffic shows up.
not_derivable: The EU-consent threshold and that the line is a deliberate minimum, not a consent solution, are not recorded in code.

evidence.summary: Footer privacy line and its placement comment.
